name: Dealing range (general ICT)

definitions.definition_text: Whenever ICT refers to a dealing range: a range where price has taken out buy side, then reversed and taken out sell side (or the reverse polarity in later examples). That high-to-low (or low-to-high) span is the dealing range.
conditions: Both sides of liquidity taken (buy side and sell side) to establish the range extremes
Range usefulness framed after both sides are taken
definitions.timeframe_session_context: General / multi-timeframe topical study — NOT specifically the NY first-hour dealing range
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from first_hour_dealing_range (9:30–10:30 FHDR). This is the general dealing-range construct from the 2022 topical lecture.

source.title: 2022 ICT Mentorship Topical Study - Dealing Ranges

definitions.definition_text: Once a dealing range is established (both buy side and sell side taken): with bearish bias, anticipate a run back up into premium for shorts; with the opposite case, anticipate trade back down into discount / discount array below the 50% of the dealing range, with FVGs as targets.
conditions: Dealing range already established (both sides taken)
Premium for shorts / discount arrays below equilibrium for continuation lower
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Intraday examples inside an established dealing range
definitions.variations_note: Use-case / targeting layer on top of the definitional occurrence — keep separate from FHDR break→FPFVG continuation.
